title: SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
abstract: arXiv:2611.07222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's text and adds model calls to every step. Provenance defenses keep the model off the final check but need a model to plan or route each task first. Where an action goes can instead be read from the tools' typed returns: an email's sender or a payment's account arrives in a typed field, while injected instructions arrive as free text. SPILLWAY turns this observation into a deterministic floor with no per-task plan. The check admits a call when each target value that appears in tool output but not in the user's task was returned by a read-only tool in a typed field or is covered by a fixed delegation rule. translated_title: SPILLWAY：将目标准入与净化分离，以防御工具使用型智能体免受提示注入攻击
translated_abstract: 工具使用型智能体会处理电子邮件、文件和支付操作，因此隐藏在网页或共享文档中的指令可能会诱使智能体将数据或资金发送给攻击者。许多运行时防御机制将放行动作的决策交给语言模型，这使得决策依赖于一个可能读取攻击者文本的模型，并且每一步都增加了模型调用。来源防御机制将模型排除在最终检查之外，但需要模型先对每个任务进行规划或路由。而动作的去向其实可以从工具的类型化返回值中读取：电子邮件的发件人或支付的账户出现在类型化字段中，而注入的指令则以自由文本形式出现。SPILLWAY 将这一观察转化为一个无需逐任务规划的确定性底线。当工具输出中出现但不在用户任务中的每个目标值，都由只读工具在类型化字段中返回，或被固定的委托规则所覆盖时，该检查才准入此次调用。一个确定性的净化机制……
tldr: SPILLWAY利用工具返回值的类型化字段（如发件人、账户）与自由文本的区别，提出一种无需语言模型参与决策或逐任务规划的确定性防御方法：只有当工具输出中出现的目标值由只读工具在类型化字段中返回或被固定委托规则覆盖时，才准入该调用，从而防御工具使用型智能体免受提示注入攻击。
en_tdlr: SPILLWAY defends tool-using agents against prompt injection with a deterministic, per-task-plan-free check that admits target values appearing in tool outputs only when they originate from read-only tools' typed fields or fixed delegation rules, avoiding reliance on language model decisions.
